network.open.outcome: The selected network application opens (a running nm-applet is not duplicated); no connection or profile changes

network.connect.outcome: A native chooser that lists available connections and activates the user's choice opens

network.edit.outcome: The native connection-profile editor opens; saving remains an explicit user action

network.radio.outcome: The Wi-Fi radio switch changes and NetworkManager reports the requested state afterwards

network.status.outcome: status_read.sh network reports backend, connectivity, primary type/state, Wi-Fi radio and signal without SSIDs or addresses

bluetooth.radio.outcome: The controller power changes after a successful state query and BlueZ reports the requested state afterwards

bluetooth.pairing.outcome: Discovery, pairing, trust and connection are separate user actions handled by a pairing agent owned by the selected manager

bluetooth.status.outcome: status_read.sh bluetooth distinguishes no controller, off, blocked and on and counts connected devices without aliases or addresses

audio.open.outcome: The selected audio application opens (an open window is focused)

audio.streams.outcome: Per-application volume and output routing are available in the selected application (policy P04)

audio.hardware.outcome: Device-level controls open: output devices for stream mixers, the ALSA mixer for hardware mixers

audio.status.outcome: status_read.sh audio reports server, output/input volume and mute (null when unknown) and whether the app controls streams

network/network-manager-applet.summary: Tray applet; edits profiles with nm-connection-editor. Connections are chosen from its tray menu only.
limitations: The connection chooser opens only from the applet's tray menu; bar and key actions for it report unsupported.
network/network-manager-applet.data_boundary: Profiles and secrets stay in NetworkManager and the keyring; nothing is migrated

network.connect.note: No command opens the tray chooser

network.edit.note: nm-connection-editor is a dependency of the applet package

network.radio.note: NetworkManager's nmcli, shared backend of every network option

theme.note: Global GTK 3 mapping (F03); tray icon presentation belongs to the bar (D01)

network/nm-connection-editor.summary: Connection profile editor. It cannot activate connections.
limitations: Choosing or activating a connection is not possible in nm-connection-editor; that action reports unsupported.
network/nm-connection-editor.data_boundary: Profiles and secrets stay in NetworkManager and the keyring; nothing is migrated

network.radio.note: NetworkManager's nmcli, shared backend of every network option

network/networkmanager.summary: nmtui in the selected terminal: separate connect and edit activities, Wi-Fi radio through NetworkManager.
network/networkmanager.data_boundary: Profiles and secrets stay in NetworkManager; nothing is migrated

network.radio.note: NetworkManager's nmcli, shared backend of every network option

theme.note: Generated libnewt palette passed as NEWT_COLORS_FILE by the network provider; terminal palette and font from D05. Legacy nmtui.sh wrappers start nmtui without it until the bar is rewired (D01).

network/plasma-nm.summary: Plasma network applet in its own window; profiles in the Plasma connection editor.

theme.note: Global Qt/KDE mapping (F03); QML applet adoption of the KDE color scheme needs VM review
